messages.author: 44a3028baa7b1f9d
messages.subject: Priors Regression Coefficients Mediation Sem
parts:
Dear all,

I am new to both the forum as well as to (b)lavaan, but I have question considering the specification of priors of regression coefficients in a mediation SEM model I am working on specifying. I would like to specify different priors for gamma21, gamma11, and beta21 in the model specified below. I know that Blavaan (using Stan) uses as default normal(0,10) and that I can change that using the dpriors command, but how could I specify 3 different priors for the different regression coefficients? I have tried adding  prior("normal(0, 25)") as example in front of the regression coefficients, but when I check the output the default normal(0,10)  is still being used. I checked different tutorials and vignettes but cannot find anything about this type of prior specification. 

modelSEMB4<- '
# measurement model
Future =~  X1 + prior("normal(0, 33)")* X2 + prior("normal(0, 33)")*X3
Studiousness =~ Y1 +  prior("normal(0, 33)")*Y2 +  prior("normal(0, 33)")*Y3
Academic =~ Y4 +  prior("normal(0, 33)")*Y5 +  prior("normal(0, 33)")*Y6

# direct effect
Academic ~ gamma21*Future
# mediator
Studiousness ~ gamma11*Future
Academic ~ beta21*Studiousness
# indirect effect (gamma11*beta21)
indirecteffect := gamma11*beta21
# total effect
total := gamma21 + (gamma11*beta21)'

mypriors<-dpriors(target="stan", nu="normal(0, 33)", itheta="gamma(.5,.5)", ipsi="gamma(.5,.5)")
bfitpstan4<-bsem(model=modelSEMB4, data = data, dp=mypriors,  n.chains = 2, burnin = 1000, sample=2000, target = "stan")

Best,
Laurent

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Priors Regression Coefficients Mediation Sem
parts:
Laurent,

There are a couple ways to do this. If you want all regression weights to have the same prior, you could add "beta" to dpriors():

dpriors(target="stan", beta="normal(0,25)")

If you want to set each prior individually, you could do something like

Studiousness ~ prior("normal(0,25)")*Future + gamma11*Future


Ed
